abstract: Combined micro-photoluminescence and Raman spectroscopies were used to disentangle charge transfer, heat conduction and strain effects at WS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/Graphene interface through pump-power and temperature controls, allowing the first accurate determination of thermal conductance at the interface.

articleTitle: Quantum Information Hardware Based on Color Center Nanophotonics
abstract: Color centers integrated into nanophotonic devices offer functionalities applied in quantum communication, simulation and computation. We explore various regimes of single-emitter and multi-emitter cavity quantum electrodynamics for applications in quantum information hardware.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Reduce Attenuation Loss in Silicabased Microstructured Optical Fibers
abstract: Fabrication of hexagonal-lattice microstructured optical fiber (MOF) with Thuliumdoped silica capillaries introduced in the first ring during stacking is presented for the first time which exhibits lower transmission loss compared to undoped MOF of similar design.

articleTitle: Colour Tunable Graded Index Refractory Metal-Oxide Metamaterials
abstract: We present refractory metal-oxide metamaterials realized using annealing techniques that exhibit vibrant colour arising from the subwavelength graded refractive index structure which can be realized across large lateral dimensions for data storage and sensing applications.

articleTitle: Complete SESAM Characterization via Equivalent Time Sampling Using a Free-Running Dual-Comb Laser
abstract: Through pump-probe measurements with a free-running dual-comb laser, we demonstrate the validity range of a two time constant dynamical model for SESAM dynamics, and use it to show the fluence dependence of the time constants.

articleTitle: SUPPOSe Deconvolution + AI Denoising: Super-resolving Sparse Signals Blurred and Buried in Noise
abstract: The deconvolution of sparse objects images is analyzed after using the SUPPOSe algorithm and its combination with artificial intelligence denoising, showing resolutions under 100nm under high noise levels.

articleTitle: Tailoring Coulomb correlations in twisted WSe2 bilayers
abstract: Phase-locked few-cycle mid-infrared pulses trace how the twist angle alone renormalizes the binding energy of excitons in twisted WSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> homobilayers by a factor of two and tunes their lifetime by a factor of twenty.

articleTitle: Enhanced Kerr nonlinear performance in graphene oxide-coated silicon and silicon nitride waveguides
abstract: Graphene oxide films are integrated with silicon and silicon nitride waveguides to demonstrate enhanced Kerr nonlinearity. Self-phase modulation with a broadening factor of 4.34 and four-wave mixing with ~9.1 dB conversion efficiency improvement are achieved.

articleTitle: Material Identification by Plasmonic Infrared Microspectrometer Employing Machine Learning
abstract: We demonstrate a microspectrometer comprising plasmonic filters integrated with an infrared camera. Blackbody light illuminates the material being studied, with transmitted light collected by the microspectrometer. The latter uses machine learning to identify the material.

articleTitle: Synchronization of quantum communication systems based on correlated photons
abstract: High-throughput quantum communication requires precise time tagging of photon detection events. Here we show how residual synchronization jitter as low as <1ps can be accomplished by autonomous correlation tracking of photon pairs, and discuss experimental results in a free-space link.

articleTitle: Highly efficient mid-infrared difference-frequency generation based on passively synchronous seeding
abstract: A watt-level ultrafast mid-infrared source was implemented based on difference-frequency generation with passively synchronous seeding, which favored a much lower pumping threshold and a maximum power conversion efficiency of 77%.

articleTitle: Entangled Photon Pair Generation from an AlGaAs-on-Insulator Microring Resonator
abstract: Time-energy entangled-photon pair generation is shown from a Q > 1 million AlGaAs-on-insulator microring resonator with an internal generation rate greater than 20×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup> pairs sec<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> mW<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup>, heralded single photon purity > 99%, and a visibility > 97%.

articleTitle: Broadband Adiabatic Couplers in Thin-Film Lithium Niobate On Insulator
abstract: We demonstrate broadband adiabatic couplers using lithium niobate on insulator (LNOI) waveguides with a footprint reduced by 98% relative to bulk LN devices. LNOI couplers with coupling efficiency >95% across telecom S-C-L bands are obtained.

articleTitle: Unlocking coherent control of the extreme ultrafast plasmonic excitation
abstract: We experimentally coherent control the extreme ultrafast excitation in plasmonic nanostructures within their coherence lifetime. We predict and demonstrate a significant enhancement of the nonlinearity greater than the nonlinearity induced by a maximally compressed pulse.

articleTitle: High-speed Silicon Mach-Zehnder Modulator with Corrugated Waveguides for Data Center Interconnects
abstract: An energy-efficient integrated silicon Mach-Zehnder modulator using 0.5 mm long corrugated waveguides with an extinction ratio of 30 dB is presented. Using this modulator, 15 Gb/s NRZ transmission is demonstrated with modulation efficiency (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf> L) of 0.065 V.cm.

articleTitle: Bidirectional electro-optic conversion reaching 1% efficiency with thin film lithium niobate
abstract: We demonstrate an efficient, bi-directional electro-optic frequency converter based on a hybrid lithium-niobate/superconductor material platform. Through materials and device engineering to mitigate the limiting photorefractive effect, on-chip conversion effi-ciency of 1% is realized.

articleTitle: From Single to Multi-scaled Periodic Surface Structure: Towards Multifunctional Surfaces Using Laser Based Microfabrication Methods
abstract: This study reports on the fabrication functionalized surfaces with enhanced properties using micro and nano-topographical features produced using laser based fabrication methods. By the combination of different structural elements, multifunctional surfaces are also produced.

articleTitle: Probing the Long-Range Transport Dynamics of Bloch Surface-Wave Polaritons by Ultrafast Microscopy
abstract: Using time-resolved microscopy, we study the long-range transport dynamics of collective excitations in an organic Bloch surface-wave polariton system. Our measurements reveal sub-ballistic transport with transient population oscillations having a finite coherence length.

articleTitle: Active spatial modulation of free electrons by controlling the shape and intensity of plasmonic fields
abstract: We present active spatial shaping of free-electron wavepackets through their interaction with specially-designed interference patterns of surface plasmons and via the nonlinear intensity dependence of the electron-plasmon interaction.

articleTitle: Femtojoule, Femtosecond, All-Optical Switching in Integrated Lithium Niobate Photonics
abstract: We introduce and demonstrate an integrated nonlinear splitter in quasi-phase matched lithium niobate nanophotonic waveguide featuring femtojoule all-optical switching with instantaneous response and 8.5 dB extinction, opening opportunities for on-chip ultrafast energy-efficient all-optical information processing.

articleTitle: Generation of tunable ultrashort X-ray pulses and delta-pulse trains in van der Waals materials
abstract: We find an X-ray generation mechanism based on van der Waals materials, which promises generation of ultrashort pulses, delta-pulse trains, and monochromatic X-ray radiation, with controllable intensity, directionality, and polarization.

articleTitle: Observation of transverse Anderson localization of mid-infrared light in a chalcogenide transversely disordered optical fiber
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate transverse Anderson localization of mid-infrared light by using a transversely disordered optical fiber made of chalcogenide glasses.

articleTitle: Topological and Localized States in Waveguide Quantum Electrodynamics
abstract: We study theoretically a periodic array of atoms coupled to a waveguide and demonstrate that atom-photon interactions lead to formation of self-induced quantum Hall phases, Hofstadter butterfly and exotic localized three-photon states.

articleTitle: Nonlinear metasurfaces with asymmetric light generation
abstract: We demonstrate a novel class of metadevices with asymmetric nonlinear response. We fabricate translucent metasurfaces that generate completely independent images in transmission for the opposite directions of illumination at the third-harmonic frequency.

articleTitle: Anomalous Floquet Thouless pumping
abstract: Here, we report a non-adiabatic topological pumping that can adiabatically manipulate anomalous Floquet topological states in a 1D periodically-driven systems. We propose and demonstrate in waveguide array simulations Thouless-like topological pumping of non-adiabatic topological systems.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Generation of Energetic Ultrashort Vortex Pulses with Spectral and Topological Charge Diversity
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of ~170-fs, ~5-nJ pulses of spectrally diverse light carrying orbital angular momentum of user-controlled topological charge by exploiting the selectivity and efficiency of the soliton self-mode conversion phenomenon in optical fibers.

articleTitle: Shot-Noise Limited Hot Electron Bolometer Integrated on Silicon-On-Insulator Photonics
abstract: Shot-noise limited (SNL) detectors that can be integrated on several photonic platforms are essential for photonic quantum technologies. We integrated small-area Hot Electron Bolometers on SOI photonics, demonstrating SNL operations with only 1.1µW of input power.

articleTitle: Carrier dynamics in nitrogen-doped graphene under THz radiation
abstract: Nitrogen is a common impurity in graphene. We combine density functional tight binding theory and a density matrix formalism to calculate the effect of nitrogen doping on the linear and nonlinear carrier dynamics in graphene.

articleTitle: Electrically Controlled Graphene Nano-Ribbon Plasmonic Conveyor Belt Network
abstract: We present a graphene nano-ribbon based plasmonic conveyor belt network for simultaneous and independent trapping and transportation of multiple nano-objects, which are entirely achieved by electrostatically varying the carrier density distribution in the graphene structures.

articleTitle: High quality factor chalcogenide microresonators with low parametric oscillation threshold
abstract: We demonstrated high-quality-factor (Q) chalcogenide (Ge-Sb-S) microresonators with intrinsic Q of 1.9×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> through an improved fabrication process, which enables a low optical parametric oscillation (OPO) threshold of 3.5 mW.

articleTitle: Time-Resolved Dynamics for Ultrashort Pulse Damage of Single-Crystal YAG in the Near-Infrared
abstract: We investigate time-resolved dynamics of single-shot laser damage on YAG for ~9fs pulses near 760nm and compare to damage thresholds of ~264fs pulses at 1025nm. Results are benchmarked against a modified Keldysh photoionization model.

articleTitle: High-resolution artificial compound eye camera: a proof-of-concept study
abstract: We suggest a new strategy for artificial compound eye camera using tapered fiber bundle. High-resolution imaging from curved microlens array is achieved, with vantages of natural insect eyes: wide field-of-view and infinite depth-of-field.

articleTitle: Super-BIC Laser
abstract: We demonstrate lasing with ultralow threshold from small-scale dielectric metasurfaces with only ~10x10 periods operating at a super-BIC regime. Engineered high-Q resonance originates from topological merging of accidental and symmetry-protected bound states in the continuum.

articleTitle: Field deployment of a multi-pass cell based mid-IR quantum cascade laser dual-comb spectrometer
abstract: We present a recent field deployment of a mid-IR quantum cascade laser dual-comb spectroscopic extractive sensing system equipped with a 76m multi-pass cell. We report the system capability in monitoring and localizing multiple gas emission sources.

articleTitle: Time lens induced by optical pushbroom effect
abstract: We show analytically and by numerical simulation an on-chip time lens based on the optical pushbroom effect. Furthermore, we demonstrate this effect inside a silicon Bragg grating waveguide. A fast free carriers front generated inside the waveguide collects and traps the energy of a signal wave with smaller group velocity tuned near to the band gap of the waveguide with hyperbolic dispersion. The energy of the signal wave is accumulated inside the front and distributed in frequency. The presented effect can be utilized to compress signals in time and space.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable near-infrared metasurfaces using phase-change materials
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a tunable hybrid metasurface benefiting from phase-change materials and plasmon hybridization for non-volatile optical modulation. We also leverage machine learning algorithms to study the effect of structural parameters on the optical performance.

articleTitle: Femtosecond Tunable Light Source with Variable Repetition Rate and Ultra-high Pulse Contrast Ratio
abstract: We demonstrate a novel femtosecond tunable light source based on a synchronously pumped fiber-feedback optical parametric oscillator with variable pulse repetition rate from 640 kHz to 41 MHz with 82 dB temporal pulse contrast ratio.

articleTitle: Infrared beam steering device based on InAsSb/(Al)GaInSb heterostructure
abstract: We describe an nBp structure comprised of waveguide with gratings for electronic steering a 10.6-µm laser and show that a 0.06 change of the refractive index by carrier injection leads to a 3.5° steering angle.

articleTitle: Simulations on the propagation dynamics of TW square-aperture CO2 laser pulses in the atmosphere
abstract: We simulate the linear and nonlinear propagation dynamics of multi-TW 10.6 μm square-frame wavepackets in the atmosphere. It is shown that the location of the obscuration is critical for multiple-filamentation and energy delivery downstream.

articleTitle: Continuous-wave electron-photon interactions using chip-based high-Q Si3N4 microresonator
abstract: We observe CW-driven electron-photon interaction using a fiber-integrated high-Q Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> microresonator, enabled by strong resonantly enhanced coupling with the confined optical mode.

articleTitle: Broadband Power Coupling and Splitting in Photonic Thouless Pump Systems
abstract: By utilizing the topological transport property of Thouless pump, we experimentally demonstrate the broadband optical power coupling and splitting on the silicon photonic platform in the telecom band.

articleTitle: Planck Spectroscopy
abstract: We developed and experimentally demonstrated a minimalistic spectroscopic technique that does not require wavelength-selective components such as prisms, gratings, or interferometers—instead using the temperature and wavelength dependence of Planck’s law of thermal emission.

articleTitle: Fibre-based pressure-controlled sources for quantum optics
abstract: We present progress towards the generation of photon triplet states and realisation of a tunable source of entangled photons. In both cases, control of the phase-matching is achieved through gas-pressure tuning.

articleTitle: Dipolar interactions in bilayers of indirect excitons
abstract: We studied both experimentally and theoretically attractive dipolar interaction in bilayers of indirect excitons (IXs) with built-in dipole moments and found monotonic IX energy reduction with density and spatial attraction between IX clouds.

articleTitle: All-Silicon, Optics-Free Microspectromer Chip Based on Vertical Waveguide Array Pixels
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a nanostructured silicon microspectrometer chip that consists of 144 pixels, each comprising an array of vertical waveguides of subwavelength period. We show that both broad- and narrow-band visible spectra can be reconstructed.

articleTitle: Deeply Subwavelength Topological Microscopy
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally imaging resolution exceeding λ/20 by a new far-field and label-free approach based on illumination with topologically structured light fields and artificial intelligence. Further improvements promise resolution beyond λ/100.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Assisted Optimization and Prediction of Absorption of Metasurfaces for Hot-Electron Generation
abstract: We use artificial intelligence techniques such as the genetic algorithm and convolutional neural networks for optimization and prediction of absorption spectra of plasmonic metasurfaces for enhancing hot-electron generation. The predictions of our algorithms agree well to experimental results.

articleTitle: Tailoring the Multipolar Content at Tight Focus Using Cylindrical Vector Beams with Orbital Angular Momentum
abstract: We demonstrate that the polarization and phase degrees of freedom of paraxial laser beams can be used to tailor their multipolar content under tight-focusing conditions. This has applications in controlling the scattering conditions from particles.

articleTitle: Permanent Optically-Induced Strain in hBN
abstract: We demonstrate the creation of permanent, localized strain structures in hBN with a phonon-resonant femtosecond laser at 7.3 µm. We spatially resolve the strain profile of the resulting micron-scale bubbles using Raman and AFM measurements.

articleTitle: Chip scale optical pumping using atomic cladded tapered nano waveguides with buffer gas
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate chip-scale optical pumping of Rubidium vapor based on novel atomic-cladded tapered nano-waveguides with different buffer-gas pressures. Precise control over the interaction volume and coupling enables the optimization of the atomic polarization.

articleTitle: Optical-Optical Double-Resonance Spectroscopy of Methane Using a Cavity-Enhanced Comb Probe
abstract: We implement a cavity to enhance the absorption of a frequency comb probe in a double-resonance measurement of sub-Doppler 3ν<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> ← ν<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> methane transitions. This yields two orders of magnitude better sensitivity in 15 times shorter acquisition time compared to previous work using a single-pass cell.

articleTitle: Fabrication of polymeric grating layers and their integration into optoelectronic devices using dip-pen nanolithography
abstract: Two-dimensional optical nanostructures grating based on polymers were fabricated using dip-pen nanolithography. We investigated the influence of both the ink composition and dwell-time. Prototypes of phase masks were manufactured, and their main characteristics were analyzed.

articleTitle: Multimode integrated SU(1,1) interferometer
abstract: We present a frequency multimode integrated SU (1,1) interferometer with a polarization converter and strong signal-idler photon correlations. Phase sensitivity below the shot noise limit is demonstrated, various filtering and seeding strategies are discussed.

articleTitle: Commissioning of a Highly Customized 1010 nm, ns-Pulsed, Yb-Doped Fiber Amplifier for On-Demand Single-Photon Generation
abstract: Parametric single-photon generation is a key technology for quantum-optical applications. Here we report on the development and commissioning of a highly specialized 1010 nm fiber amplifier for such a novel parametric single-photon source.

articleTitle: Boosting Fluorescence-Based Chiral Sensing with Nanophotonics
abstract: The handedness of chiral molecules can be detected in their circularly polarized fluorescence, which is typically very weak. Here, we propose dielectric nanophotonics to increase both the fluorescence intensity and polarization contrast.

articleTitle: Magnetic-free Nitride Optical Isolator on Chip
abstract: We demonstrated a magnetic-free optical isolator for Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> photonics using AlN piezoelectric actuators. Maximum of 10 dB isolation and <1 dB insertion loss is achieved under 100 mW RF power applied at each actuator.

articleTitle: Analytical Expression of Raman Induced Soliton Self-Frequency Shift
abstract: We derive an analytical expression that predicts the Raman-induced frequency shift experienced by a soliton. By including fiber losses, dispersion slope, and self-steepening, the resulting expression is a high-order extension of Gordon’s formula.

articleTitle: Phase tomography of spontaneously emitted photon-pairs
abstract: We have directly measured the joint spectral phase of spontaneously emitted photon-pairs for the first time. We have devised a novel tomographic method using quantum interference of bi-photon functions. This method can potentially be used for quantum sensing.

articleTitle: Light stopping by reflection from a moving index front
abstract: Nonlinearly generated refractive index fronts in waveguides can change the signal frequency and wavenumber leading to the indirect transitions. Here, we discuss how dynamic light stopping and pulse time reversal can be implemented in dispersive waveguides via these transitions. Our scheme, in contrast to previous concepts of light stopping and time reversal, is not limited by a strict phase matching condition and does not require local index variations, thus, can manipulate broadband signals in a single step process. The presented results are experimentally feasible using existing photonic waveguides technologies.

articleTitle: A Concept Study on Time-Gated Raman Spectroscopy for the Process Industry
abstract: A time-gated Raman spectrometer designed to meet the requirements of a hygienic industrial process analyzer is presented. It is shown that fluorescence effects can be discriminated effectively to reveal the superimposed Raman spectrum.

articleTitle: Half-Wave-Plate based Adaptive Polarization Controller
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated an endlessly adaptive polarization controller based on a rotatable half-wave-plate on the lithium niobate platform. It is recommended to eliminate the carrier fading in a self-coherent communication system.

articleTitle: Teleportation-based Protocols with Hybrid Entanglement of Light
abstract: We report an entanglement swapping protocol implemented between single-photon entanglement and hybrid discrete- and continuous-variables entanglement of light, allowing the connection of disparate nodes in a heterogeneously-structured quantum internet.

articleTitle: A Neuromorphic Graphene UV Phototransistor
abstract: We demonstrate an artificial neuron by integrating graphene with flash memory. The structure exhibits neural plasticity by doping graphene via trapped charges in a nitride layer, with potential applications in memory, tunable plasmonics, sensing, etc.

articleTitle: Characterization of Micromirrors Embedded in Parylene Photonic Waveguides for Out-of-plane Light Delivery
abstract: We have recently demonstrated flexible Parylene photonic waveguides with embedded micromirrors. Here, the out-of-plane beam profile of the micromirrors is characterized using a combination of simulation and experiments.

articleTitle: Femtosecond Time-Resolved Infrared-Resonant Third-Order Sum-Frequency Spectroscopy Towards Label-Free Imaging
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a time-resolved infrared-resonant third-order sum-frequency spectroscopy. This technique provides a new way to measure the dynamics of the infrared active vibrational states. It can be combined with microscopes for label-free imaging.

articleTitle: Broadband Dual-Pumped Normal-GVD Kerr Combs
abstract: We demonstrate broadband Kerr comb generation spanning >250 nm in a normal group-velocity-dispersion silicon-nitride microresonator using two frequency-nondegenerate pumps. Numerical modeling using a modified Lugiato-Lefever equation reveals the onset of switching waves.

articleTitle: Fundamental limits to the excitation of polaritons in thin films
abstract: Polaritonic modes in two-dimensional van der Waals materials display short in-plane wavelengths compared with light in free space. However, such large confinement is accompanied by poor in/out optical coupling, which severely limits the application of polaritons in practical devices. Here, we quantify the coupling strength between light and 2D polaritons in thin films using accurate rigorous analytical methods. In particular, we obtain universal expressions for the cross sections associated with photon−polariton coupling by point and line defects, as well as with polariton extinction and scattering processes. Additionally, we find closed-form constraints that limit the maximum possible values of these cross sections. Our results bear fundamental interest for the development of 2D polaritonics and the design of applications based on these excitations.

articleTitle: Cryogenic Optical Transitions in 77Se+ Implanted Si for On- Chip Spin-Photon Interfaces
abstract: We examine and verify the mid-infrared transitions of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">77</sup>Se<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> deep donors in Silicon. We aim to use implanted Se ions as nuclear-spin/photon interfaces for on-chip quantum repeater structures.

articleTitle: Two-beam coupling at the epsilon-near-zero wavelength in indium tin oxide
abstract: Two-beam coupling enables tailoring of the optical nonlinearity in hot electron based nonlinear materials. Polarization- and chirp-dependent pump-probe measurements in indium tin oxide are found to be in good agreement with theory.

articleTitle: An Optical Parametric Amplifier for seeding femtosecond Fe:ZnSe lasers at 4.1 µm
abstract: Mid-infrared pulses with 200 nJ energy and 200 nm bandwidth were generated at 4.1 µm and 60 kHz repetition rate. The highly-stable LiGaS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-based Optical Parametric Amplifier was pumped by a turn-key, commercially available Yb:KGW laser.

articleTitle: Polarization twisting dual-pulse generation
abstract: The polarization twisting frequency, helicity, and time delay between two pulses, can be manipulated individually via a modified Michelson interferometer with inserting a pellicle beam splitter into each arm.

articleTitle: Confocal Spatial frequency modulation imaging with wavelength domain modulation
abstract: We present a novel single element detector imaging scheme in which spatial information is encoded into the spectral content of a broadband source. The technique is confocal when delivered with optical fiber.

articleTitle: High-Power CW Optical Parametric Oscillator Design for gap-free Wavelength Tuning across the Visible
abstract: A tunable laser light source based on continuous-wave optical parametric oscillator technology is demonstrated to achieve output powers at the Watt-level while providing a tuning range of more than 260 nm across the visible spectrum.

articleTitle: Localized field enhancements and anapoles in subwavelength-engineered silicon nanodisks
abstract: We report the design and characterization of sub-wavelength engineered all-dielectric silicon nanodisks supporting localized field enhancements and anapoles in the near infra-red and verify the presence of the resonant mode through polarization resolved reflectance measurements.

articleTitle: Non-linear Response of CdSe/CdS Quantum Dots Driven by Intense Terahertz Pulses
abstract: We report on the observation of quantum confined stark effect (QCSE) in CdSe/CdS core/shell quantum dots (QDs) directly driven by an intense THz field, generated in the organic crystal DAST, which is pumped with multi-millijoule mid-IR pulses.

articleTitle: Shallow donor qubits in ZnO for quantum memory applications
abstract: Neutral shallow donors in ZnO are promising candidates for solid-state spin qubits. Here, we report on the suitability of shallow donor qubit ensembles for quantum memory applications.

articleTitle: Engineering Nearest Neighbor Coupling in Huygens Metasurfaces
abstract: Nearest neighbor coupling in antenna systems tends to reduce the overall optical efficiency of the system. Here, we compare arrays of disc and donut resonators that confine the impinging beam locally. Maximum optical efficiency of 70% for anomalous refraction is achieved.

articleTitle: Tuning Light-Hole Optical Transition in Highly Tensile Strained Germanium Quantum Wells
abstract: A new low-dimensional system consisting of a highly tensile strained Germanium quantum well (QW) was epitaxially grown on Si wafers using GeSn as barriers. The thickness of the well was modulated from 12.5nm, down to 1.5nm, whereas the tensile strain was increased from 1.1% to 1.67%. Infrared spectroscopic ellipsometry was used to investigate the optical activity of the QWs.

articleTitle: Multi-photon Fock-state generation via climbing the Fock ladder
abstract: We demonstrate the enhanced generation of Fock-states with up to three photons using a parametric down-conversion source that combines time-multiplexing and quan-tum feedback and outperforms conventional state generation methods.

articleTitle: A high-speed micro-ring modulator for next generation energy-efficient optical networks beyond 100 Gbaud
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon micro-ring modulator supporting 128 Gb/s NRZ modulation with SNR=5.2, ER=3.8dB, 0.8 Vpp drive swing, and 5.3 fJ/bit power consumption. We have also achieved 192 Gb/s PAM-4 modulation with TDECQ of 2.5dB.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of 8-Gbit/s QPSK Communications Using Two Multiplexed Orbital-Angular-Momentum Beams in the 0.27-0.33 THz Range
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an 8-Gbit/s QPSK communication link using two multiplexed OAM beams at ~0.3 THz frequency. By tuning the frequency spacing between two lasers, such a system can be operated in the 0.27-0.33 THz range.

articleTitle: Up to 50 dB Extinction in Broadband Single-Stage Thermo-Optic Mach-Zehnder Interferometers for Programmable Low-Loss Silicon Nitride Photonic Circuits
abstract: We demonstrate single-stage thermo-optic Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> interferometers with (46.1±2.5) dB average extinction ratio over 1460-1640 nm (≈50× of typical devices). We analyze performance requirements for creating reconfigurable high-quality-factor resonators in programmable circuits using such interferometers.

articleTitle: High Accuracy Intrusion Pattern Recognition using a Dual-Stage-Recognition Network for Fiber Optic Distributed Sensing System
abstract: A dual-stage-recognition network combined with the fiber optic DAS system is designed to realize a high accuracy intrusion pattern recognition in practical complicated environments. Field test is performed to verify an average recognition accuracy rate of 97.04% for five typical events including animals, human and mechanical movement.

articleTitle: Visible Wavelength Beam Steering in Silicon Nitride Nanophotonic Phased Arrays with a Supercontinuum Laser
abstract: In this work, beam steering angle of 65is achieved on a 32-channel antennas phased array. We demonstrate a wide range of beam steering in visible band with a supercontinuum laser for the first time.

articleTitle: Slope Assisted Brillouin Optical Time Domain Analysis Using Dual Frequency Probe with Gain and Loss Spectra
abstract: We demonstrate a slope assisted Brillouin optical time domain analysis using dual frequency probe light amplified by Brillouin gain and attenuated by Brillouin loss, which generates linear output against temperature change.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Assisted Pre-Carrier Phase Recovery EVM Estimation for Coherent Transmission Systems
abstract: We exploit deep supervised learning and amplitude histograms of coherent optical signals captured before carrier phase recovery (CPR) to perform time-sensitive and accurate error vector magnitude (EVM) estimation for 32 Gbaud mQAM signal monitoring purposes.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of a WDM-based Integrated Optical Decoder for Compact Optical Computing
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a 3-8 wavelength-division-multiplexing (WDM) based optical decoder using microring-based add-drop switches and filters. The proposed decoder has a smaller footprint and consumes lower power compared with previous designs.

articleTitle: Velocity random walk and dynamic range of laser-driven precision optomechanical inertial accelerometers
abstract: Here we present a full study and characterization of our fabricated precision optomechanical accelerometer with an 8.2 µg/Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sup> VRW and 50.9 µg/Hz bias stability, with innovative RF readout, suitable for inertial applications.

articleTitle: A 3.2-Gbps Beam Expanded Robust Uplink WDM OWC System Based on 860-nm and 940-nm VCSELs
abstract: We proposed an 860-nm and 940-nm commercial VCSELs-based 1.5-meter 3.2-Gbps beam expanded robust uplink wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) system which can ignore collimation of the optical path within an area of 97.65 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Terahertz Generation in Thin-film Lithium Niobate Platform
abstract: We demonstrate spectrally and temporally tailored terahertz radiation from optical rectification o f 100 pJ femtosecond pulses in low-loss thin-film lithium niobate waveguides that are co-integrated with terahertz antennas. A maximal emission frequency of 440 GHz is achieved.

articleTitle: Receiver IQ Imbalance and Skew Compensation By Frequency Domain 4x2MIMO Equalizer
abstract: We propose a frequency domain 4x2 multi-input and multi-output (MIMO) equalizer for long-haul transmission systems, which can compensate receiver IQ imbalance and Skew with lower computational complexity than time domain 4x2 MIMO.

articleTitle: Silicon Nitride Waveguide-Integrated Silicon Photodiodes for Blue Light
abstract: We demonstrate silicon nitride waveguide-integrated silicon lateral p-i-n photodiodes at λ=488nm. A 50-µm long device exhibits a dark current of 178pA at -5V, a responsivity of 0.31 ± 0.01A/W, and an external quantum efficiency of ~78%.

articleTitle: Efficient Leaky-Wave Antenna for Terahertz Wireless Communications
abstract: We study the radiation properties of leaky-wave antenna at terahertz frequencies for wireless communications. We introduce a novel aperture design that increase the efficiency and directionality of the generated beams.

articleTitle: Detection of near- and far-field radiation pattern of a silicon-on-insulator optical phase array
abstract: We experimentally measured the radiation of optical phased arrays fabricated on SOI waveguide platform. By tuning the input laser wavelength, we realized one-dimension beam steering and observed standing-wave patterns in the waveguide antennas.

articleTitle: Sub-millimeter large high-speed photodetector for FSO communications
abstract: We present a 0.4-mm-large high-speed photodetector (PD), formed by series and parallel connected integration of 40 μm diameter PDs. We successfully achieved the same 3-dB bandwidth (8.5 GHz) as that in 40 μm single PD.

articleTitle: Ghost Imaging Counterfactually
abstract: We have developed a protocol for ghost imaging that is always counterfactual while imaging an object, no light interacts with it. This provides both better visibility/SNR and less absorbed intensity than ghost imaging.

articleTitle: Chirp-like-Polyphase-Sequence based DCrT-S-ACO-OFDM for Bandwidth-limited Direct-detection Systems
abstract: We propose a novel DCrT-S-ACO-OFDM based on chirp-like polyphase sequences. Experiments of a 34.4-Gbit/s direct-detection ACO-OFDM system under 10-GHz system bandwidth limitation show that the proposed scheme outperforms conventional ACO-OFDM, DFT-S-ACO-OFDM and OCT-precoded ACO-OFDM.

articleTitle: Narrowband microwave-photonic notch filtering using Brillouin interactions in silicon
abstract: We present narrowband RF-photonic filters in an integrated silicon platform. Using Brillouin interactions, the filters yield narrowband (~MHZ) filter bandwidths with high signal rejection, and demonstrate tunability over a wide (∼GHz) frequency range.

articleTitle: Dynamic Crosstalk Monitoring of Real-time Transmission in Multi-core Fibers Based on Deep Learning
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a novel dynamic crosstalk monitoring in multi-core fibers based on deep learning, by using asynchronous amplitude histogram (AAH). The mean absolute error (MAE) of crosstalk monitoring is below 0.78 dB.

articleTitle: Compact, Energy-Efficient, and Low-Loss Thermo-Optic Silicon Optical Phase Shifter
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a compact silicon optical phase shifter based on thermo-optic effect. The loss, power consumption, modulation bandwidth, and footprint are 0.77 dB, 3.1 mW/π, 38 kHz, and 45 × 45 µm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, respectively.

articleTitle: Angled interconnection between standard single-mode fiber and nested nodeless antiresonant fibers
abstract: We present angled interconnection between standard single-mode fiber and nested nodeless antiresonant fibers achieving an insertion loss of 0.45 dB and return loss below -60 dB over a wide (1450-1650 nm) spectral range.

articleTitle: High Shift Efficiency O-band Spoked-Ring Modulator Allowing Fully Electro-Optic Channel Tuning in a 45nm CMOS Platform
abstract: Vertical-junction microring modulators are demonstrated in a 45 nm CMOS platform, showing record O-band resonance-shift efficiency 30 GHz/V. This enables wavelength locking and tolerance/temperature compensation without thermal tuning, for efficient, wide parallel optical buses and cryogenic links.

articleTitle: Non-volatile silicon photonic switches based on phase change materials
abstract: We report nonvolatile electrically reconfigurable photonic switches using PCM-clad waveguides and microrings actuated by in-situ silicon PIN heaters. High extinction ratio (~15 dB), near-zero extra loss, and high cyclability (> 3000) are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Integrated Optical Phased Array for Temperature Sensing
abstract: We report a simple concept to realize an optical phased array for temperature sensing. A maximum sensitivity of 0.0132 °/K was obtained at = λ1.45µm. This work shows the promise of versatile OPA for optical sensing applications.

articleTitle: Error-Free Kerr Comb-Driven SiP Microdisk Transmitter
abstract: We demonstrate the first SiP microdisk modulated Kerr comb source with BER better than 1E-9 up to 16 Gb/s/λ. The modulated lines span 44.3 nm bandwidth, paving the path to a comb-driven integrated SiP transmitter.

articleTitle: Performance Impairments due to Inter-Core Crosstalk Dynamics in a 7-core MCF-based DMT-modulated Link
abstract: We investigate inter-core crosstalk impact on DMT-modulated signals in a 7-core fiber with different sources at the same nominal wavelength. We observe beating from relative laser frequency shift leads to time-dependent interference on DMT subcarriers.

articleTitle: Integrated Nonvolatile Phase-shifter Based on Electrically Reconfigurable Low-loss Phase-change Materials
abstract: We demonstrate a nonvolatile, small-form-factor (20 µm) phase-shifter based on low-loss phase-change materials (Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>Te<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> and Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>) on SOI waveguides. We achieve continuous optical phase modulation and an MZI switch with 30 dB extinction ratio.

articleTitle: Dark-Pulse Dynamics and Directional Switching in Photonic-Crystal Ring Resonators
abstract: Microcomb generation under normal dispersion requires an external phasematching condition, which we fulfill with a photonic crystal (PhC) in a ring resonator. The bidirectional coupling induced by the PhC leads to a non-trivial direction of propagation and breathing of the nonlinear pulse state.

articleTitle: FMCW ranging and speed measurement based on frequency sweep predistortion of DFB laser
abstract: An iterative method for generating linear frequency sweep from a DFB laser at 1550nm is demonstrated. An object with speed of ~6m/s at 7m is detected by the FMCW lidar, indicating a good sweep linearity.

articleTitle: Low-Cost OFDR Distributed Fiber Sensing Enabled by Fiber with Enhanced Rayleigh Backscattering
abstract: This paper shows that a low-cost diode laser with 1-nm tuning range can perform effective optical frequency domain reflectometry distributed sensing measurement using a fiber with strong Rayleigh backscattering profile.

articleTitle: Raman-Kerr Combs in High-Q Chalcogenide Microresonators Coupled to Silicon Waveguides
abstract: We report the observation of Kerr frequency combs and Raman lasing in a high-Q (Q>1.5e6) As<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</inf>S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">80</inf> microresonator monolithically integrated with silicon-on-insulator waveguides.

articleTitle: Optical Fiber Photonic Crystal Hydrophone for Acoustic Bio-Sensing
abstract: We fabricate, assemble, and characterize a compact, robust, and scalably-fabricated photonic crystal hydrophone capable of measuring acoustic signals from single cardiomyocytes with a minimum detectable pressure of $3\mu Pa/\sqrt {Hz} $ and a 19 kHz band-width.

articleTitle: Broadband Terahertz Time-Domain Imaging Using a Terahertz Focal-Plane Array
abstract: We present a terahertz time-domain imaging modality based on a terahertz focal-plane array. The imaging system has more than a 60-dB signal-to-noise ratio and can resolve terahertz images up to 2.5 THz.

articleTitle: A Codesigned Photonic Electronic MAC Neuron with ADC-Embedded Nonlinearity
abstract: We present a reduced-precision integrated photonic electronic multiply-accumulate (MAC) neuron with ADC-embedded nonlinearity. The proposed device trades off speed with resolution, outperforming both analog and digital electronic solutions in terms of speed and energy consumption. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Low-power, thin and flexible, stacked digital LC lens for adaptive contact lens system with enhanced tunability
abstract: By stacking multiple thin and flexible LC based lenses, we experimentally demonstrate a low-power adaptive optical system with enhanced focusing tunability that is suitable for integration with a smart contact lens system.

articleTitle: Direct attachment of optical fibers to photonic integrated circuits with in situ UV curing
abstract: Here we present direct attachment of multiple optical fibers to PIC chips at arbitrary pitches. Each fiber is actively aligned and then "tacked" by directly transmitting UV light down the fiber itself.

articleTitle: Anti-parity-time-symmetric integrated optical gyroscopes
abstract: Parity-time-symmetric optical gyroscopes are gaining interest for the enhanced sensitivity shown by exceptional points. The real splitting of anti-PT-symmetric gyroscopes is more reliable for stability and readout scheme than the complex splitting of parity-time-symmetric gyroscopes.

articleTitle: Recognition of OAM state using CNN based deep learning for OAM shift keying FSO system with pointing error and limited receiving aperture
abstract: In this paper, we study the performance of OAM shift keying FSO system with pointing error and limited receiving aperture using CNN based demodulator. The results show that the recognition accuracy can reach 98% with pointing error and weak turbulence.

articleTitle: Secure High Dimensional Quantum Key Distribution Based on Wavelength-Multiplexed Time-Bin Encoding
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated high-dimensional quantum key distribution with wavelength-multiplexed time-bin encoding, with photon information efficiency up to 4.082 secure-key bits/photon and secure-key rate up to 237-kbit/s. Security will be verified with dual-basis Franson interferometers.

articleTitle: Intelligent Structure Monitoring for Tunnel Steel Loop Based on Distributed Acoustic Sensing
abstract: A tunnel steel loop reinforcement invalidation monitoring technology based on optical fiber distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) is proposed and demonstrated. Assisted with machine learning, the identification accuracy rate of invalid degree is up to 97.8%.

articleTitle: Entangled Two-Photon Absorption in Commercial Fluorophores
abstract: Our study addresses the applicability of simple and common fluorophores for entangled two-photon fluorescence microscopy. Using CW-pumped SPDC waveguides, we can measure linear absorption rates of entangled photons in standard fluorophores in life science.

articleTitle: Gigahertz supercontinuum comb generation by two-pulse bound state
abstract: We theoretically and experimentally demonstrate the gigahertz supercontinuum combs generated by a two-pulse bound state. The repetition rate is about 18.75 GHz and the combs extend over 270 nm.

articleTitle: Drone-Based Quantum Key Distribution
abstract: Current quantum cryptography implementations focus on fiber-based or fixed free-space point-to-point channels. We seek to expand this to quantum communication from mobile platforms. Here, we report progress towards tracking system stabilization and air-to-air signal coupling.

articleTitle: High Bit Resolution, Wavelength-Insensitive Coherent Electro-Optic Digital-to-Analog Converters Based on Circuit Topology
abstract: An electro-optic digital-to-analog converter consisting of Si cascaded Y branches presented wavelength-insensitive 4-bit-converted analog intensity with an identical input voltage of < 50 mV. The same configuration demonstrated up to 8-bit operation.

articleTitle: All-Fiber Wavelength-Switchable Orbital Angular Momentum (OAM) Laser Assisted by Fiber Bragg Grating and Fabry-Perot Interferometer Directly Inscribed in Erbium-Doped Fiber with Femtosecond Laser
abstract: We demonstrate an all-fiber wavelength-switchable orbital angular momentum (OAM) laser assisted by fiber Bragg grating (FBG) and Fabry-Perot interferometer (FPI), which are directly inscribed by femtosecond laser in ring-core erbium-doped fiber.

articleTitle: Quality Control of Ethanol-Based Hand Sanitizer Gels in Micro-Opto-Fluidic Devices
abstract: We present a smart micro-opto-fluidic platform for quality control of ethanol-based hand sanitizer gels. Analyses rely on the study of the near infrared absorption features of fluids flowing in rectangular glass micro-capillaries with integrated reflectors.

articleTitle: Networked Swept-Source Raman Sensors
abstract: Raman spectroscopy with large-area, spectrally-selective detectors and tunable lasers enables distributed chemical sensing where excitation light can be delivered via optical datacom networks. Distributed sensing over 100’s of meters and multiple locations is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Evolution of nonthermal electrons in pump-probe electron relaxation dynamics
abstract: We study the relaxation of photoexcited electrons in graphite using TR-ARPES. Observed nonthermal electron distributions are modelled using Boltzmann rate-equations, leading to the identification of nonthermal phases in the fluence-delay phase space with broad implications.

articleTitle: Timing Jitter of Fractal Superconducting Nanowire Avalanche Photodetectors in the 2-Micrometer Wavelength Range
abstract: We developed a femtosecond, mode-locked thulium-doped fiber l aser t o characterize fractal superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors at 1993 nm. The lowest timing jitter was 64.8 ps, which should be compared with 29.2 ps at 1560 nm.

articleTitle: Higher-Order Topological States in the Extended Two-Dimensional SSH Model and Their Electric Circuit Implementation
abstract: We demonstrate that couplings between diagonal next-nearest neighbor sites give rise to higher-order topological corner states observed recently in the microwave experiments with coupled resonator arrays realizing two-dimensional Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model.

articleTitle: Characterization of a THz Electric Field using Precision Spectroscopy of Molecular Ions
abstract: SI-traceable calibration of the amplitudes and phases of the Cartesian components of a THz electric field may be performed by comparing measurements of the lighshifts of HD<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> two-photon rovibrational transitions with molecular ion theory predictions.

articleTitle: Confined Exciton Interaction of Erbium Doped GaAs Quantum Wells Elucidated by Multidimensional Coherent Spectroscopy
abstract: We investigate the exciton exchange interaction of erbium doped GaAs quantum well using MDCS. We observe an energy shift of ~100µeV consistent with the predicted exchange energy and different pulse sequences activate specific excitonic pathways.

articleTitle: Direct Current Frequency Chirping of Diode Laser Injection Locked to WGMR
abstract: We investigate the possibility of frequency chirping of single mode diode laser selfinjection locked to WGMR via driving current modulation. Maximum frequency deviation of LD locked to WGMR is measured as well as backward wave phase impact on LD linewidth.

articleTitle: Monolithic Bilayer Metasurface for Multicolor Phase-Amplitude Holography
abstract: We propose a monolithic bilayer metasurface platform for phase-amplitude holograms operating at up to three colors, in both visible and infrared regimes.

articleTitle: Near-Infrared 10-GHz Astrocomb With Mode Identification
abstract: We present a 10-GHz astrocomb spanning 1.15–1.8 µm and based on a spectrally broadened degenerate optical parametric oscillator. Absolute mode identification is provided by a Fourier-transform spectrometer cross-calibrated to the comb-mode spacing.

articleTitle: Isolating solitons from the resonant continuous wave by using nonlinear Fourier transform
abstract: Pure solitons are isolated from the resonant continuous wave background arising in a fiber laser by utilizing nonlinear Fourier transform, which is great helpful to investigate the soliton interaction correctly.

articleTitle: Resonant chalcogenide-metal-fluoropolymer nanograting for tunable pyroelectric sensing
abstract: A resonant pyroelectric detector was demonstrated to support narrowband and tunable photopyroelectric effect in the near-infrared region. The narrowband pyroelectric device was built on a chalcogenide-metal-fluoropolymer (As<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-Ag-PVDF) nanograting membrane, which was fabricated inexpensively using a solvent-assisted imprint lithography process. Under the resonant condition, the device exhibited a responsivity of 1.36 V/W. The device’s absorption and pyroelectric characteristics can be tuned using a bias voltage applied to the membrane.

articleTitle: Multipoint Curvature Sensing with Multicore Fiber Bragg Gratings and Two-Photon Absorption Process in Si-APD
abstract: Multipoint curvature sensing with multicore fiber Bragg gratings is realized using intensity correlation measurement based on two-photon absorption process in Si-APD, where reflection spectra from multiple gratings with almost the same Bragg wavelengths are discriminated.

articleTitle: EIT Cooling of Atoms in Optical Dipole Traps
abstract: Neutral atoms trapped in an array of optical dipole traps are EIT-cooled to a temperature of T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</inf> = 2.8 µK. With an observed EIT cooling rate of 1400 /s for theory limt of n<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> = 0.03, we measure the average quanta of n = 1.5.

articleTitle: Xenos peckii's Compound Eye Structure Inspired Flat Microlens Array for Super-resolution Imaging
abstract: Inspired by compound eye structures found in insects, we demonstrate an ultrathin arrayed camera enabled by a flat multilevel diffractive microlens array for super-resolution visible imaging, with resolution improvement factor of 1.4 compared to the diffraction limit.

articleTitle: Intensity Statistics: a Fingerprint for Waves Evolution in the Diffusion Regime
abstract: We demonstrate that intensity statistics is nonstationary in diffusive regimes of waves in reflection from random media. A statistical model based on recurrent scattering and near field coupling is proposed and confirmed experimentally.

articleTitle: Single Molecule Detection of Fluorophores "Turned-on" by Corrosion Reactions
abstract: Real-time, single-molecule "turn on" of resazurin by the corrosion of iron was detected by a modern fluorescence microscope to overcome the previous limitations of corrosion detection, opening up a new spatiotemporal regime for studying corrosion.

articleTitle: Amplified spontaneous emission and lasing in photonic time-crystals
abstract: We find that the spontaneous emission in the momentum bandgap of photonic time-crystals is amplified exponentially by the periodic modulation. When inserted in a resonator - it can give rise to lasing without threshold.

articleTitle: Structured Illumination Microscopy Using Coupled Nanoridge Arrays
abstract: Structured illumination microscopy using arrays of nanoridges is investigated. A resolution of ~50 nm (λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> = 458 nm) is demonstrated. Compared to approaches leveraging surface-plasmon-polaritons, the coupled nanoridges improve the super-resolution by more than 10%.

articleTitle: A Novel Geometry for integrated Photonic Characteristics of Colloidal Quantum Dots and micro-LED
abstract: We report a novel structure of U-shaped micro-LED to reduce the lateral leakage and explore the impact on QDs beside the quantum wells. Furtherly, optimize the utilized region of red QDs to reduce cost. Finally, make reliability test at 100 A/cm2 to make sure the usage region for red QDs.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum Generation in Optofluidic Microstructured Optical Fibers
abstract: Supercontinuum generation in microstructured optical fiber with CC<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">C</inf> as a core-material is presented. The sample provides a new dispersion landscape with the zero-dispersion-wavelength approaching telecommunication wavelengths allowing for intense nonlinear frequency broadening across near-infrared.

articleTitle: Highly efficient terahertz generation using 3D Dirac semimetal Cd3As2
abstract: We present Cd<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>As<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> as a promising candidate for terahertz generation by lever-aging its significant third-order optical nonlinearity. We predict an efficiency over 5000 times that of LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> in a propagation distance of 300 nm.

articleTitle: Longitudinal 3D Visualization of Choroidal Neovascularization in a Rabbit Model using Multimodal Photoacoustic Microscopy and Optical Coherence Tomography Molecular Imaging
abstract: This study presents novel chain-like cluster gold nanoparticles as a multimodal contrast agent for photoacoustic microscopy (PAM) and optical coherence tomography (OCT) to longitudinally visualize choroidal neovascularization in living rabbits.

articleTitle: Ultra-Thin All-Epitaxial Plasmonically Enhanced Long-Wave Infrared Detectors
abstract: We demonstrate all-epitaxial surface plasmon-polariton enhanced type-II superlattice nBn infrared detectors with sub-diffractive absorber thicknesses. Our devices show peak external quantum efficiencies of 50% at 10.4 µm in a 300 nm absorber (~ λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>/35).

articleTitle: Coupled Multicore fibers for Dual-point Refractive Index Measurements
abstract: Simultaneous measurement of refractive index (RI) in liquids is demonstrating by using multicore fibers to spectrally encode the intensity changes observed when the fiber tip is immersed in the tested liquid.

articleTitle: Atomic Quantum Wires in Ising-spin Chain Models
abstract: We implement quantum wires in Rydberg atom systems to program graph-connected Ising spins. With auxiliary atoms arranged in wires, we show that non-adjacent qubits are on-demand coupled for an Ising Hamiltonian of arbitrary graph connections.

articleTitle: Nanoscale Multiband Surface-enhanced Raman Spectroscopy by Multiresonant Nanolaminate Plasmonics
abstract: By supporting multiple hybridized plasmonic modes within individual nanocavities, metal-insulator-metal nanolaminate plasmonic nanostructures on nanopillar arrays can enable nanoscale multiband SERS with large enhancement factors (> 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup>) over a wide visible to near-infrared spectral range.

articleTitle: Silicon photonic MEMS phase shifter with µs time constant built on a foundry platform
abstract: MEMS enable low power tuners in silicon photonics, but existing phase shifters lack in range, speed, and loss. We implement a 2π phase shifter with a 1.54 µs time constant and 0.5 dB insertion loss in IMEC’s iSiPP50G platform.

articleTitle: High Harmonic Generation in Topological Chiral Crystals
abstract: We demonstrate perturbative optical harmonic generation up to fifth order in the topological chiral crystal RhSi under femtosecond mid-infrared excitation, with particularly strong third harmonic responses that may be linked to Berry curvature contributions.

articleTitle: Ultra-narrow linewidth GaAs-based DBR Lasers
abstract: We present a novel approach for GaAs-based DBR diode lasers with an extended cavity. The developed chips exhibit a record small 3 dB linewidth of 25 kHz @ 1 ms at the wavelength of 1064 nm.

articleTitle: Enhanced random lasing performance of CH3NH3PbI3 perovskite in AgI configuration
abstract: We demonstrate that the random lasing behavior of solution-processed MAPbI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> perovskites can be improved around 3 times in light intensity enhancement and pumping threshold reduction with the existence of AgI configuration.

articleTitle: Oxygen Stress Response of Nitrifying Bacteria monitored with Raman Spectroscopy In Vivo
abstract: Raman spectroscopy with cytochrome-c resonant excitation enables the stress monitoring of slow growing bacterial cultures with very low cell counts based on only a few hundred cells per culture and measurement.

articleTitle: On-Chip Multi-Layer THz Power Generation with Beamforming Capability
abstract: In this article, we propose a novel on-chip multi-layer coupled oscillator scheme to generate THz power using industry standard 65-nm CMOS process. The scalable architecture enables to generate 14 dBm effective isotropic radiated power (EIRP) in a lensless setup with beamforming capability of ±30 degrees in both E and H planes at 416 GHz. The generated coherent power is radiated through on-chip 4×4 array of patch antennas.

articleTitle: Integrated thin-film lithium niobate non-reciprocal circulator
abstract: We demonstrate an integrated electro-optic frequency circulator on thin-film lithium niobate. Our device operates at telecommunications wavelengths, exhibiting frequency conversion and isolation of 37.3 dB, with insertion loss of 3.8 dB.

articleTitle: Unidirectional electronic currents in asymmetric nanojunctions driven by strong optical fields
abstract: We show the creation of unidirectional currents in nanojunctions in strong optical fields at ambient conditions, with no phase stabilization of the driver. The mechanism is rooted in the inter-cycle interference of the electronic wavepackets in the nanogap.

articleTitle: Mid-IR supercontinua in dispersion-engineered As2S3-silica nanospike waveguides pumped by fs pulses at 2.8 μm
abstract: We report generation of coherent octave-spanning mid-infrared supercontinua in As2S3-silica waveguides pumped by a custom-built 2.8 μm femtosecond fiber laser. The fabricated hybrid waveguides are demonstrated to be long-term stable and water-resistant.

articleTitle: Microring Modulators in a New Silicon Photonics-Optimized 45 nm Monolithic Electronics-Photonics SOI CMOS Platform
abstract: We report on microring modulators in the new 45CLO photonics-optimized 45 nm electronic-photonic CMOS platform. Interdigitated disk and vertical-junction rib microring designs are demonstrated, with 20 GHz bandwidth at 25 Gbps data rate.

articleTitle: Multiple pulse-mode Bell states heralded via entanglement swapping
abstract: A novel scheme is presented for simultaneous heralding of multiple distinct pulse-mode entangled states via frequency-resolved Bell-state measurements. The heralded states are verified using spectral measurements and two-photon interference.

articleTitle: Training photonic extreme learning machines using feedback alignment
abstract: Photonic extreme learning machines and reservoir computers enhance machine learning by efficiently mapping data to a high dimensional space. We demonstrate training the input mapping of such approaches using feedback alignment improves performance.

articleTitle: Deep nonlinear optical neural networks using physics-aware training
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate deep nonlinear optical neural networks using a universal algorithm for backpropagating through arbitrary physical input-output transformations. Ultrafast second harmonic generation and other diverse processes are trained to perform image and audio classification.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Carrier Dynamics in (Bi1-xInx)2Se3 Thin Films: From Topological to Band Insulator
abstract: Replacing some of the Bi atoms with In transforms Bi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> from a topological to a band insulator. We have used time-resolved terahertz spectroscopy to study carrier dynamics in (Bi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</inf>In<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> films across this transition.

articleTitle: Coherent Excitation of Hexagonal Boron Nitride Single Photon Emitters via Optical Repumping
abstract: Coherent excitation of quantum emitters in hexagonal boron nitride is inhibited by electron decay into intermediate dark states or spectral diffusion. We present an optical co-excitation scheme to reduce these transitions and amplify the photoluminescence.

articleTitle: Overcoming the Manley-Rowe Limit for CW Terahertz Generation in Q-Engineered Multimodal Cavity
abstract: We present a method to overcome the Manley-Rowe limit in a Q-factor engineered multimodal nonlinear cavity. Cascading nonlinear processes enable continuous-wave terahertz generation with a theoretical conversion efficiency of 98.8%.

articleTitle: Enabling Quantum Technologies with Photonics
abstract: Through the systematic exploitation of Quantum mechanical effects, we will experience technological revolutions in 21st century. With the foundation of Q.ANT, we have made it our mission to make a significant contribution to this revolution.

articleTitle: Ultrafast photo-induced melting of the trimer superstructure in TaTe2
abstract: We report the first ultrafast study of TaTe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, utilizing MeV-scale ultrafast electron diffraction to reveal rapid photo-induced melting of its low-temperature trimer super-structure. Density-functional calculations indicate intra-trimer charge transfer as a trigger of this transformation.

articleTitle: Effect of Strain in WS2 Monolayer Integrated Excitonic Photodetector
abstract: We investigate the effect of local non-homogeneous strain on WS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> monolayer when integrated on a SiN photonic waveguide showing a strong spectral responsivity(80mA/W) at exciton wavelength(620nm) and shift of ~10nm in photodetector device.

articleTitle: Hybrid Probabilistic-Geometric Shaped LDPC-coded PM- 16QAM in 140 km DWDM Metro Network Communication
abstract: We implement a hybrid probabilistic-geometric shaping (PGS) LDPC-coded PM-16QAM in a 140 km DWDM metro-network-communication link. We experimentally demonstrate that hybrid PGS LDPC-coded-modulation scheme can provide 0.95 dB improvement over corresponding uniform-distribution-based scheme.

articleTitle: Third harmonic generation from thin gradient ternary mixture layers
abstract: By analyzing the third harmonic generation from gradient layers of the amorphous dielectric ternary mixture material Hf<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">y</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">z</inf> we are able to derive the third order nonlinear susceptibility of the material.

articleTitle: Custom Terahertz Pulses for Nonlinear Vibrational Excitation
abstract: We combine THz pulses from two complimentary crystals to increase peak field strength and create a broad, smooth spectrum. We show the utility of using this strong THz pulse to nonlinearly excite vibrations in solids.

articleTitle: Unlocking the Ultrafast Charge Transfer in Colloidal CsPbBr3/GO Heterostructure
abstract: We studied the ultrafast charge transfer in type II CsPbBr<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/GO heterostructure in the strongly coupled regime to unlock their potential for perovskite solar cells and photodetectors. We demonstrate that GO act as potential hole-transport layer.

articleTitle: 11× temporal compression in an ultra-silicon-rich nitride chip
abstract: Strong temporal compression in an integrated ultra-silicon-rich nitride temporal compressor consisting of separate nonlinear and anomalously dispersive stages is demonstrated. 11× compression of 5.8ps pulses at a low input peak power of 13.3W and 9.4× increase in the pulse peak power is achieved.

articleTitle: Fano Resonances in Individual Dielectric Nanoantennas
abstract: We employ azimuthally polarized laser beams to demonstrate experimentally variations of the Fano resonance profiles in the linear spectra of individual AlGaAs nanoantennas and reveal their links to optical bound states in the continuum.

articleTitle: Real-time imaging of surface waves with nonlinear near-field optical microscopy
abstract: We introduce nonlinear near-field optical microscopy (NNOM), capable of real-time evanescent wave imaging by nonlinear wave mixing. Using NNOM, we exhibit phase-resolved polarization- and spin-sensitive near-field mappings of plasmonic patterns using only standard optical components.

articleTitle: Generation of Multiple Sharp Fano Resonances based on a Silicon Nanobeam-Microring Resonator
abstract: A silicon nanobeam-microring resonator is experimentally demonstrated to generate periodic multiple sharp Fano resonances with an FSR of 8.44 nm. The extinction ratios of the Fano resonances are higher than 11 dB.

articleTitle: Laser cooling of ytterbium-doped silica glass by more than 6 Kelvin
abstract: We report nearly an order of magnitude improvement over the lowest temperature achieved in laser-cooling of Yb-doped silica glass. The 6K cooling relative to the ambient temperature was achieved by pumping the sample at 1035nm.

articleTitle: Perfect soliton crystal in an AlN microresonator
abstract: Near octave-spanning perfect soliton crystal (1150-2100 nm) is successfully demonstrated in an AlN microring resonator, at an on-chip power of 250 mW. A measured 60-fs ultra-short pulse confirms the high coherence of the soliton crystal.

articleTitle: Global quantum communication with untrusted space-based networks
abstract: Most efforts in space-based global quantum communications focus on trusted networks. Here we analyse use of space-borne quantum memories and show that it provides much faster entanglement distribution rates than the existing hybrid architectures.

articleTitle: A low-noise telecom interface for silicon-vacancy quantum network nodes
abstract: Fiber-based quantum networks employing atomic memories require an interface between visible and infrared photons. We demonstrate low-noise conversion between silicon vacancy wavelengths and the telecom O-band for use in a deployed quantum network.

articleTitle: Athermal WDM (de)multiplexer based on polysilicon cascaded Mach-Zehnder interferometers in bulk CMOS
abstract: We demonstrate an athermal WDM (de)multiplexer by realizing strip/subwavelength grating polysilicon waveguide based cascaded MZIs in bulk CMOS. Measured temperature sensitivity for all channels is around -20 pm/<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</sup>C with a slope of -0.25 pm/<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</sup>C/nm.

articleTitle: Guiding light at criticality and beyond
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate waveguiding at the critical angle in a dielectric multi-layered structure. At this exceptional point, the waveguide becomes scale invariant and the field is confined to the low-index region, with a spatially-uniform transverse profile.

articleTitle: Imaging-based Optofluidic Biosensors Enabled by All-dielectric metasurfaces
abstract: We present optofluidic label-free biosensors leveraging high quality-factor resonances emanated from bound-states-in-the-continuum and novel data processing. The sensors are based on imaging and offer solutions to remove sophisticated spectroscopy instrumentations towards point-of-care applications.

articleTitle: Hybrid Guiding in a Multi-mode Slab Waveguide
abstract: We demonstrate the hybrid guidance of a pulsed field endowed with precise spatio-temporal structure in a 25-mm-long multi-mode thin-film waveguide. Group delay measurements confirm that the modal indices can be tuned independently of the waveguide parameters.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable semiconductor currents driven by ultrafast coherent control with structured light
abstract: We apply femtosecond pulses with vectorized or structured spatial modes to coherent control of currents. We excite and measure complex and reconfigurable current patterns in a semiconductor, with an emphasis on generating magnetic fields.

articleTitle: Encoding Qubit-Qudit States in Photon Polarization and Picosecond Time-Bins
abstract: We introduce a qubit-qutrit information system realized by two degrees of freedom in a single photon: polarization and picosecond time-bin. We demonstrate creation and reconstruction of states in this framework using quantum state tomography [5].

articleTitle: Absolute laser ranging with sub-µm resolution from a free-running dual-comb Yb:CaF2 laser
abstract: We present absolute laser ranging with sub-µm resolution enabled by a free-running dual-comb diode-pumped Yb:CaF2 laser. At an update rate of 952 Hz, we achieve a relative resolution of more than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup> within the ambiguity range of 1.1 m.

articleTitle: Modular 3D-Printed Plasmonic Circuits for Signal Processing in THz Communications
abstract: THz waveguide-based integrated solutions are of great utility in Terahertz communications. In this work, we propose a new type of modular 3D-printed micro-encapsulated two-wire plasmonic waveguide components to realize reconfigurable terahertz circuits for signal processing.

articleTitle: Imaging the dynamics of 2D polariton wavepackets
abstract: We use ultra-fast electron microscopy to measure the spatio-temporal dynamics of phonon-polariton wavepackets in a thin hBN sample. The electron probe enables recording the wavepacket formation, propagation, and decay, unveiling intriguing acceleration & deceleration phenomena.

articleTitle: Spatial-spectral characteristics of pulses from multi-pass cell and multiple-plate continuum compressors
abstract: Spatial-spectral characteristics of Yb:KGW laser pulses passing through a multi-pass cell and a multiple-plate continuum are analyzed. The former exhibits slightly better spectral homogeneity under the same degree of spectral broadening due to less B-integral per pass.

articleTitle: Two-Dimensional Terahertz Spectroscopy of Collective Excitations in Solids
abstract: Using two-dimensional (2D) terahertz spectroscopy we investigate fundamental electronic, lattice, and spin excitations in solids, and the couplings between them.

articleTitle: Doppler-Free Two-Photon Cavity Ring-Down Spectroscopy of a Molecular Vibrational Overtone Transition
abstract: We demonstrate Doppler-free two-photon cavity ring-down spectroscopy using a narrow linewidth quantum cascade laser locked to a high-finesse cavity. Two-photon absorption of $^{14}{{\text{N}}_2}^{16}{\text{O}}$ at ${\tilde v_0} = 2207.507{\text{c}}{{\text{m}}^{ - 1}}$ is reported.

articleTitle: 10-Hz, 636-ps, 1064-nm, All Polarization-Maintaining Fiber Front-End Based on Ultrafast Optical Fiber Pulse Chopping
abstract: We propose a robust 10-Hz, 1064-nm, 636-ps, sub-µJ, all polarization-maintaining fiber front-end, which was realized by a combination of Sagnac loop and EO phase modulator for sub-ns-level optical chopping together with two AOM stages.

articleTitle: Effect of Thickness of a Dye-doped Polymeric Film on the Concentration Quenching of Luminescence
abstract: We have studied the dependence of concentration quenching of luminescence on the thickness d of dye-doped polymeric films (HITC:PMMA) and found a strong inhibition of the donor-acceptor energy transfer (concentration quenching) at small values of d.

articleTitle: On-Chip Optical Tweezers Based on Micro-Reflectors
abstract: We introduce a new class of on-chip optical tweezers with high trapping efficiency, compact footprint, and broadband operation by integrating free-form micro-reflectors to the facets of waveguides.

articleTitle: UV laser-induced spatially selective deep oxidation of GaAs
abstract: UV laser-induced surface oxidization and spontaneous periodic surface patterning of monocrystalline GaAs wafers is presented here. Irradiation of the semiconductor's (100) surface with UV laser radiation (244 nm) in ambient conditions results in the formation of regular periodic surface structures, known as laser-induced periodic surface structures (LIPSS). At the higher end of the irradiation intensities used in our experiments the periodic oxide features merge to form a continuous porous oxide layer with a thickness of ~0.4 μm.

articleTitle: Fabrication of Silver Coral-like AFM Probes for Tip-Enhanced Raman Spectroscopy by ICP-based approach
abstract: We describe a novel approach for the fabrication of plasmonic probes designed for Tip Enhanced Raman Spectroscopy (TERS) applications, based on the nano-structuration of Ag-coated commercial AFM probes via Inductively Coupled Plasma (ICP) discharge.

articleTitle: Magnetically Tunable Goos-Hänchen Shifts in Topological Quantum Materials
abstract: We theoretically investigate the Goos-Hänchen (GH) shifts on the surface of a topological insulator (TI) thin film in the presence of an externally applied magnetic field. The potential applications are in optical heterodyne and bio-sensors.

articleTitle: A Chip-Based Brillouin Laser Gyroscope with Earth-rotaton-rate Sensitivity
abstract: The physical principles of a chip-based Brillouin laser gyroscope are reviewed. The device can resolve sinusoidal rotations with amplitude as low as 5 degrees/hour and is also used to detect the Earth’s rotation.

articleTitle: Efficient Broadly Tunable Waveguide Lasers in Yb3+:CaF2 Produced by Deep Diamond Saw Dicing
abstract: High-aspect-ratio ridge waveguides (propagation losses: 0.13±0.05 dB/cm) were fabricated in Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:CaF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> by diamond-saw-dicing. The waveguide laser generated 723 mW at 1029-1051 nm with a slope efficiency of 76.0%; wavelength tuning between 1009-1072 nm was achieved.

articleTitle: Statistical learning multiobjective optimization for large-scale achromatic metalens at visible regime
